sections.heading: Modernise applications. Connect your enterprise.
sections.body:
Modernise applications, automate operations and connect every channel your customers use.

We combine specialist engineering services with our own software – Linkworks and testoriumz – and reusable accelerators, so modernisation moves faster, every release is assured and change is delivered cyber-safe.

items.title: Cloud services
items.description: Modernise, migrate and optimise enterprise cloud environments through engineering, DevOps and automation

sections.heading: Six specialist services. *One transformation partner.*
sections.body: From applications and cloud foundations to automated operations and connected customer journeys, bring your next stage of change together.

cards.title: App moderni­sation
cards.description: Cloud, DevOps & microservices. Rethink legacy applications, strengthen delivery practices and design intuitive experiences for the people who use them.

cards.title: Automation & RPA
cards.description: UiPath, Blue Prism & AI workflows. Automate repetitive operations and connect people, software bots and business processes.

cards.title: Integration services
cards.description: APIs, Boomi & enterprise integration. Connect applications, data and workflows across cloud and on-premises environments.

cards.title: WhatsApp Business & omnichannel
cards.description: WhatsApp Business: Conversational service & commerce. Omnichannel: Connected journeys, every channel. Bring customer conversations and business workflows together.

cards.title: Quality engineering
cards.description: Test automation & AI code assurance. Build quality into delivery with continuous testing and Linkfields’ own testoriumz quality engineering platform.

cards.title: Cloud services
cards.description: Consulting, migration, development, Kubernetes and infrastructure. Build and run the cloud foundations that support your digital transformation.

sections.heading: Software we own, *built into delivery*

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Modernise legacy systems, transform applications and build scalable digital solutions with cyber-safe delivery to meet evolving enterprise needs.

items.title: testoriumz
items.description: Quality engineering platform for continuous testing: test management, low-code automation, root-cause analysis, dashboards and CI/CD integration. Replaces a fragmented tool estate with one platform.

sections.description: Our own software and reusable accelerators sit behind every engagement, licensed on their own or delivered with our services.
sections.note: Modernisation & Integration Toolkit · Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework · Automated Testing & Release Assurance Packs · Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: Where we lead with *outcomes*
sections.description: Every play starts from a customer problem. Our five portfolios and Linkfields software sit behind each one.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-generated code increases delivery speed and assurance risk.
plays.outcome: Quality and security gates across CI/CD for AI-written change.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: Complex migration and customisation create regression and integration risk.
plays.outcome: Migration readiness, automated regression, integration rebuild and security validation.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Cost-to-serve pressure creates demand for process intelligence and automation.
plays.outcome: Discover, redesign and automate work across process and customer channels.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: Persistently Innovative
sections.description: A technology partner that modernises, runs, analyses, secures and scales the enterprise, combining specialist services with our own software and reusable delivery IP. Headquartered in South Africa, delivering globally.
